entries.detail: Removed author-only fields; added module descriptions/orders; merged studyNotes into keyPoints and commonTraps/examDistinctions into examTraps; normalized source basis, scope, objectives, and sourceAudit.

Changed all 38 gaps from draft to verified; replaced source-based/proposed-gap-closure with source-grounded/gap-audit; retained mandatory routing tags; removed pseudo-slide labels and generic course-anchor text.

The author claimed the sixth edition used about 10 ATP per acetyl-CoA. Local PDF page 218 explicitly applies 3 ATP/NADH and 2 ATP/FADH2, giving 12 with GTP; catalog now preserves that source convention.

Replaced misassigned carbohydrate transcript ranges (notably lines 24-91 and 92-138) with topic-accurate segment mappings; split both course-note PDFs page by page and inventoried all six SRT companions.
Removed an uncited high-affinity claim for GLUT3 and rewrote the gap to the chapter-supported fact that GLUT3 is the primary neuronal isoform.
Reframed the local-source claim as increased oxygen delivery and cited pages 193-194; removed uncited chronic-hypoxia/deoxyhemoglobin detail from the gap.
Removed alanine from the cited E1-deficiency claim; pages 212-213 directly support pyruvate diversion to lactate.
Removed the avidin vignette because avidin occurs only in the chapter self-assessment, not cited narrative page 228; retained the biotin-dependent pyruvate-carboxylase target.
Added page 216, which explicitly links odd-chain fatty-acid propionyl-CoA to succinyl-CoA, alongside page 226 net-glucose logic.
Extended the locator through page 267, which provides the sorbitol-to-fructose reaction needed to justify sorbitol avoidance.
Removed insulin-regulated adipose LPL, which is not stated in the specified chapter/transcript, and rewrote the gap around chapter-supported apoC-II activation, TAG hydrolysis, and adipose uptake.

Removed or narrowed unsupported abetalipoproteinemia, ApoE2 homozygosity, neonatal pancreatic immaturity, sn-3 gastric specificity, biliary secretin, and insulin-driven adipose glycerol-3-phosphate claims.
Removed the glucose-alanine cycle because it is not directly developed in the specified local chapters/material; preserved alanine as a gluconeogenic substrate under the substrate concept.
Replaced a true-but-nonresponsive phosphorylase statement with an unambiguously false, parallel distractor.
All 158 repository baseline records remained byte-for-byte untouched; SHA-256 18df3da7eea257542623d965f1f8b3258c9c1709734bf0c85ec054a321f72ab3.

All 38 author gaps were retained after verification; 6 received substantive stem/option/explanation edits, 3 additional items received material locator corrections, and all 38 received release-contract/source-field normalization. Excluded count: 0.
